description: This file defines an interface for a grain in an Orleans-based distributed system, specifying asynchronous methods for client addressable operations and stress testing.

classes.name: IClientAddressableTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface for client addressable testing, including methods for setting targets and stress tests.

methods.name: SetTarget
methods.description: Sets the target client object for the grain.

methods.name: HappyPath
methods.description: Processes a message and returns a string asynchronously.

methods.name: SadPath
methods.description: Processes a message without returning a value, asynchronously.

methods.name: MicroSerialStressTest
methods.description: Performs a serial stress test with specified iteration count.

methods.name: MicroParallelStressTest
methods.description: Performs a parallel stress test with specified iteration count.
